name: Hazuki Nagisa
source:
Nagisa is a first-year boy who also goes to Iwatobi High School. He is very spirited and not afraid to speak his mind. He has admired Haruka's swimming since elementary school and enrolls at his high school hoping to swim with him again. He comes up with the idea to start the swim club at Iwatobi High, and is treasurer for the club.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Free!_(anime)]Wikipedia[/url]]
